verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own `tofu plan` previews the changes needed to bring infrastructure in line with configuration. Its refresh-only mode is documented as reconciling state with "changes made to remote objects outside of OpenTofu", which is the core of detecting drift between declared configuration and actual cloud resources. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of drift-reporting output or exit codes for automated detection, any documented recurring or continuous drift checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can detect drift between my declared configuration and the actual cloud resources

citations.quote: Refresh-only mode: creates a plan whose goal is only to update the OpenTofu state and any root module output values to match changes made to remote objects outside of OpenTofu.
The `tofu plan` command creates an execution plan, which lets you preview the changes that OpenTofu plans to make to your infrastructure.
